claims.source_quote_ar: قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: (فِي الْآخِرَةِ) : يَجُوزُ أَنْ يَكُونَ ظَرْفًا
claims.claim_ar: يجوز أن تكون «في + اسم» ظرفًا عاملاً أو أن تكون حالًا؛ وبذلك يجوز أن تُعرب «فِي آيَاتِنَا» ظرفًا متعلقًا بـ«يَسْعَوْنَ» أو حالًا يبين حالة سعيهم.
claims.claim_en: The prepositional phrase 'في + noun' may function either as a ظرف (adverbial) or as a حال. Thus 'فِي آيَاتِنَا' can be parsed as an adverbial (circumstantial) attached to 'يَسْعَوْنَ' or as a hal (describing their manner/state while striving).
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited passage treats the example (فِي الْآخِرَةِ); application to (فِي آيَاتِنَا) in this āyah is a generalization from that example and should be verified against any explicit commentary on this verse.

claims.claim_ar: مُعَاجِزِينَ يحتمل أن تُعرب حالًا منصوبةً تصف حالَ سعيهم (حال من فعل «يَسْعَوْنَ»).
claims.claim_en: The participle 'مُعَاجِزِينَ' may be parsed as a accusative hal (a circumstantial state) describing how they strive — i.e., a hal related to the verb 'يَسْعَوْنَ'.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source gives a general allowance that an element may be a حال, but it does not discuss this specific participle in this verse; alternative analyses (e.g. نعت, خبر) are possible and should be checked against explicit commentary.
